info.title: Swiss Bank Master API v3
info.description: The Swiss Bank Master API allows to access master data required for electronic payments in Switzerland. All participants connected to the Swiss payment systems SIC and euroSIC are listed.

tags.name: bankmaster
tags.description:
**Bankmaster API**
All public REST endpoints of the bank master data are located here, such as the bank master data as JSON and downloadable files.

totalSize.description: The total count of records in the entries list.

validOn.description: Master data is edited and published on a daily basis. Therefore the data is valid on that exact date only.

readTime.description: Date and time (according to ISO 8601) at which this response was created.

iid.description: Each bank / financial institution is identified by an IID (institution identification). IIDs are three to five digits long. QR-IIDs consist exclusively of numbers from 30000 to 31999.

validOn.description: Date to which the information in a record applies. This date (written as per ISO8601 standard) is identical for all records.

entryType.description: "New IID/QR-IID" must be used instead of "IID / QR-IID" if entryType is BankMasterConcatenated.

newIid.description: If this field contains a number, the IID/QR IID is no longer valid (e.g. due to a merger) and is to be replaced by the "New IID" (so-called concatenation).

sicIid.description: This is always a 6-digit number and may be used only by SIC and euroSIC participants.

headQuarters.description: IID of the headquarters of this participant. If this is the record of the headquarters itself, then this field contains the same value as the field IID.

iidType.description: Provides information as to the respective type of entry.

qrIidBelongsTo.description: IID of the bank/financial institution to which this QR IID is assigned to. It only contains a value, if the field iidType contains a QR_IID. Otherwise the field is empty.

bankOrInstitutionName.description:
Name of participant
Notice:
+ at the beginning of the name of the bank/institution = in liquidation
++ at the beginning of the name of the bank/institution = alternation of purpose

country.description: 2-digit alphabetical country code according to the ISO standard 3166.

lsvBddChfParticipation.description: Participation in LSV+/BDD in CHF (as debtor FI).

lsvBddEurParticipation.description: Participation in LSV+/BDD in EUR (as debtor FI).

iid.description: Each bank / financial institution is identified by an IID (institution identification). IIDs are three to five digits long. QR-IIDs consist exclusively of numbers from 30000 to 31999.

IbanResponse.description: IBAN validation result and IID if available.

IbanValidationResult.description:
Validation result. Possible values:
- OK                    # This IBAN is formally correct
- INVALID_COUNTRY_CODE  # This IBAN has an invalid country code
- INVALID_LENGTH        # This IBAN has an invalid length
- INVALID_FORMAT,       # This IBAN is formally incorrect according to ISO-13616-1
- INVALID_CHECKSUM      # This IBAN has an invalid checksum
- INVALID_IID           # This IBAN has an invalid CH or LI institution identification (IID)

type.description:
An absolute URI that identifies the problem type.
We may provide human-readable documentation for the problem type in the future, when the URI is dereferenced.

title.description: A short, human readable summary of the problem type.
title.example: Request parameter has missing or invalid values

status.description:
The HTTP status code generated by the origin server for this occurrence
of the problem.

detail.description:
A human readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the
problem.
detail.example: The submitted request contains invalid or missing request parameters which cannot be processed.

instance.description:
An absolute URI that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem.
It may or may not yield further information if dereferenced.

@type.description: The field "@type" contains a URI/name identifying the type.

data.description: An object of type @type containing custom fields.

GenericObject.description: Structured type that contains an object and its type.
GenericObject.example: When associated with a 'Problem', it typically contains values which caused the failure and similar. May not contain sensitive CID.

message.example: The health check GET request was successfully received and processed.

requestDateTime.description: According to RFC3339, section 5.6 in ISO 8601 with timezone and milliseconds.

headerName.description: The name of the provided header.

environmentStage.description: The instance to which the request was sent to.

applicationVersion.description: The version of the API backend.
